# orchestra_skills (Data Source)

Agent skills in the workspace, including the ones Orchestra publishes, which an `orchestra_agent` can use by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The skills Orchestra publishes, by name.
data "orchestra_skills" "published" {
  orchestra_managed = true
}

output "published_skill_ids" {
  value = { for s in data.orchestra_skills.published.skills : s.name => s.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `orchestra_managed` (Boolean) true for only the skills Orchestra publishes, false for only the workspace's own. Unset returns both.
- `search` (String) Only skills whose name or description contains this.

### Read-Only

- `skills` (Attributes List) The matching skills. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))

<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) When an agent should use it.
- `id` (String) The skill ID.
- `name` (String) The skill name.
- `orchestra_managed` (Boolean) Whether Orchestra publishes it.
